name: Siansa Beats (dev)
author: Siansa
description: For Siansa Dev, an experiment: the Siansa plugin's loudness and fades with each song's tempo, beats, bars and phrases from Siansa Beats (Beat This!). Installs next to the Siansa plugin and reads what it measured; measures nothing itself.

versions.changelog: Adds each song's key and scale, as AudioMuse-AI analysed them, for Siansa Dev's smart blends.
Passes on Siansa Beats' lock-in points, bass, energy, drops and breakdowns, and sends song changes marked as bad in Siansa Dev to Siansa Beats' list.
First version: profiles from the Siansa plugin's measurements with the beat grids from Siansa Beats.
